map.📋 KDIGO 急性肾损伤诊断与分期标准: 📋 KDIGO diagnostic and staging criteria for acute kidney injury
map.↑≥3倍基线 或 ≥353.6 μmol/L 或 需透析: ↑≥3 times baseline or ≥353.6 μmol/L or dialysis required
AKI diagnosis: Scr rises ≥26.5 μmol/L within 48h, or rises ≥1.5 times baseline within 7 days, or urine output falls to the above criteria.
map.提示：AKI分期取肌酐标准和尿量标准中较高者。AKI 3期需紧急肾内科会诊，评估: Note: AKI staging takes the higher of the creatinine criterion and the urine output criterion. AKI stage 3 requires urgent nephrology consultation to assess dialysis indications. Common causes: prerenal (hypovolemia, heart failure), renal (ATN, AGN, AIN), postrenal (obstruction). A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：急性肾损伤 KDIGO 分期: 📚 In-depth analysis: acute kidney injury KDIGO staging
map.比值=180/80=2.25(≥2.0)→AKI 2 期；同时增量 100µmo: Ratio=180/80=2.25 (≥2.0) → AKI stage 2; the increment of 100 μmol/L is also >26.5, so the more severe stage applies.
map.基线 80、当前 144：比值 1.8(1.5–1.9)→1 期，监测尿量避免肾: Baseline 80, current 144: ratio 1.8 (1.5–1.9) → stage 1; monitor urine output and avoid nephrotoxic drugs.
map.肌酐分期与尿量分期取较重者；RRT 即归 3 期。: Take the more severe of the creatinine stage and the urine output stage; if RRT is needed, it is stage 3.
map.与基线同单位比较，注意 µmol/L 与 mg/dL 换算(×88.4)。: Compare in the same unit as baseline; note the conversion between μmol/L and mg/dL (×88.4).
